description: We are a passionate team of innovators, tech enthusiasts, and problem-solvers driven by a shared curiosity for space exploration and Earth science. Our goal for the NASA Space Apps Challenge is to build a creative, impactful, and practical solution to tackle one of this year's exciting challenges. We value collaboration, creative thinking, and turning complex data into real-world applications.
summary:
​AstroHealth Monitor is an integrated, AI-powered health monitoring software designed to safeguard astronauts during deep-space missions. Extended spaceflight exposes crew members to severe physiological and psychological stressors, including microgravity-induced muscle atrophy, bone density loss, radiation exposure, and communication delays with Earth. To address these challenges, our software collects real-time biometric data from wearable biosensors—tracking heart rate variability, sleep cycles, blood oxygen levels, and radiation dosage.
​Using edge-computing algorithms, the platform analyzes vital signs locally on the spacecraft, eliminating reliance on delayed ground-control communications. It detects early anomalies, predicts potential health risks, and provides automated, personalized countermeasures such as tailored exercise routines, nutritional adjustments, and mental wellness prompts. Additionally, an intuitive dashboard allows crew medical officers to monitor overall team health at a glance and access offline diagnostic protocols during emergencies. AstroHealth Monitor ensures autonomous, proactive healthcare, maximizing crew safety and mission success in extreme extraterrestrial environments.
